587844ef-16a5-43ce-935a-e0a7dd157a31.content: NLP stands for [Natural Language Processing](https://www.google.com/search?q=Natural+Language+Processing). It is the driving force behind various common applications such as [Language Translation](https://www.google.com/search?q=Language+Translation) applications like Google Translate, [Word Processors](https://www.google.com/search?q=Word+Processors) like Microsoft Word and Grammarly that employ NLP to check grammatical accuracy of texts, [Interactive Voice Response (IVR)](https://www.google.com/search?q=Interactive+Voice+Response) applications used in call centers, and [Personal Assistant](https://www.google.com/search?q=Personal+Assistant) applications like OK Google, Siri, Cortana, and Alexa.

dbcd442a-c61d-4f7e-8eb9-4adb17a49f69.content:
There are two main types of knowledge: 

1. **[Declarative Knowledge](https://www.google.com/search?q=Declarative+Knowledge)**: Declarative knowledge is to know about something. It includes [concepts](https://www.google.com/search?q=concepts), [facts](https://www.google.com/search?q=facts), and [objects](https://www.google.com/search?q=objects). It is also called [descriptive knowledge](https://www.google.com/search?q=descriptive+knowledge) and expressed in declarative sentences. It is simpler than [procedural language](https://www.google.com/search?q=procedural+language).

2. **[Procedural Knowledge](https://www.google.com/search?q=Procedural+Knowledge)**: Procedural knowledge is a type of knowledge which is responsible for knowing how to do something. It can be directly applied to any task. It includes [rules](https://www.google.com/search?q=rules), [strategies](https://www.google.com/search?q=strategies), [procedures](https://www.google.com/search?q=procedures), [agendas](https://www.google.com/search?q=agendas), etc. It is also known as [imperative knowledge](https://www.google.com/search?q=imperative+knowledge).

cae6701f-a380-4ea9-b334-eee36234ac28.content:
There are four basic types of [machine learning](https://www.google.com/search?q=machine+learning): 
1. **[Supervised learning](https://www.google.com/search?q=Supervised+learning)**: In this type of machine learning, data scientists supply algorithms with labeled training data and define the variables they want the algorithm to assess for correlations. Both the input and the output of the algorithm is specified. 
2. **[Unsupervised learning](https://www.google.com/search?q=Unsupervised+learning)**: This type of machine learning involves algorithms that train on unlabeled data. The algorithm scans through data sets looking for any meaningful patterns or relationships.
3. **[Semi-supervised learning](https://www.google.com/search?q=Semi-supervised+learning)**: This type of machine learning combines elements of both supervised and unsupervised learning, where the algorithm is trained on a mix of labeled and unlabeled data.
4. **[Reinforcement learning](https://www.google.com/search?q=Reinforcement+learning)**: In this type of machine learning, the algorithm learns by interacting with an environment and receiving feedback in the form of rewards or penalties. 

These types of machine learning are used to solve different types of problems and are chosen based on the type of data and the goal of the project.

ac72dcee-cebd-4b39-92ee-5bb6106bed23.content:
Uninformed Search Techniques, जिन्हें पूर्व ज्ञान के बिना खोज तकनीकें भी कहा जाता है, वे [Heuristics](https://www.google.com/search?q=Heuristics) का उपयोग किए बिना समस्याओं का समाधान करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली तकनीकें हैं। इन तकनीकों में [Graph](https://www.google.com/search?q=Graph+in+Computer+Science) या [Tree](https://www.google.com/search?q=Tree+Data+Structure) को खोजते समय कोई भी जानकारी या पूर्व ज्ञान का उपयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 

इस प्रकार की तकनीकों में शामिल हैं:

* [Breadth-First Search (BFS)](https://www.google.com/search?q=Breadth-First+Search): यह तकनीक Graph या Tree के सभी नोड्स को एक-एक करके खोजती है, जिसमें पहले पड़ोसी नोड्स को खोजा जाता है।
* [Depth-First Search (DFS)](https://www.google.com/search?q=Depth-First+Search): यह तकनीक Graph या Tree के एक नोड से शुरू करती है और जितना हो सके गहराई तक जाती है, इससे पहले कि वह अन्य नोड्स की ओर बढ़े।
* [Uniform Cost Search (UCS)](https://www.google.com/search?q=Uniform+Cost+Search): यह तकनीक Graph या Tree के नोड्स को उनकी लागत के अनुसार खोजती है, जिसमें सबसे कम लागत वाले नोड को पहले खोजा जाता है।

इन तकनीकों का उपयोग [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.google.com/search?q=Artificial+Intelligence) और [Machine Learning](https://www.google.com/search?q=Machine+Learning) में विभिन्न समस्याओं का समाधान करने के लिए किया जाता है।
